data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 霜雪王陵的孤峰立誓
data.description: 寒风呼啸的大雪陵园古碑前，积雪覆盖大地。阿蕾克希亚单手将配剑深深刺入雪地，狂风卷起银发，眼眸中是绝对不向命运屈服的光芒。
data.location: windswept snow-covered royal cemetery surrounded by dark withered pines
data.action: standing tall in heavy blizzard, one gloved hand resting firmly on sword pommel thrust into snow, piercing crimson gaze locked forward
data.lighting: 雪地反射苍白冷光与铅云天光
data.promptProse: Alexia stands unyielding in a swirling blizzard cemetery, gloved hand planted on her sword thrust into deep snow, crimson eyes blazing with conviction.
data.animaCaption: Swirling snowflakes whirl past her silver hair as she anchors her blade in the snow.
